goal: Injection review: SQL, command, template and LDAP inputs kept apart from code.
use: Injection review: SQL, command, template and LDAP inputs kept apart from code. Use when code builds queries, commands or templates from input.

steps.note: Find the sinks. List each query, command, template and directory query.
Check construction. Flag any string built with input.
Check parameters. Each input must reach the sink as a parameter or escaped value.
Check the framework. Flag raw query helpers used where a safe API exists.
Report. Each sink with file and line, severity and the fix.
